name: mobile data
label: Mobile data

modes.title: No mobile data
modes.symptom: phones showing signal bars but no data session
customer_says: I've got full signal on my phone, but the internet won't work at all unless I'm on Wi-Fi.
My mobile data has stopped. Calls are fine, but no apps will load when I'm out of the house.
There's no data on my phone. The little 4G symbol has gone and nothing connects.
My phone says it has signal, yet I can't open a single web page or send a picture message.

causes.cause: a failed packet gateway serving the area
fixes: switching customers over to the standby packet gateway

causes.cause: a subscriber database that stopped answering data requests
fixes: restarting the subscriber database nodes one by one

causes.cause: a broken link between the mast controllers and the data core
fixes: re-establishing the link between the mast controllers and the data core

workarounds: switch the phone to 3G only in the network settings
use Wi-Fi calling and home Wi-Fi where they are available
aftercare: turn flight mode on and off so the phone registers again
put the network mode back to automatic if it was changed

modes.title: Slow mobile data
modes.symptom: mobile data speeds dropping to a crawl at busy times
customer_says: My mobile data is unbelievably slow. Maps won't load and music keeps cutting out.
The internet on my phone has slowed right down. It shows 4G, but it behaves like dial-up.
Data on my phone is barely moving. A photo takes minutes to send.
I've got signal and data, but everything takes an age to load when I'm in town.

causes.cause: a capacity licence that expired on the area's masts
fixes: reinstating the capacity licence on the masts

causes.cause: a microwave backhaul dish knocked out of alignment
a speed cap applied to the wrong group of customers

workarounds: download maps and playlists over Wi-Fi before travelling
turn on the data saver option so pages load in a lighter form
aftercare: restart the phone to pick up the restored speed
turn the data saver option off again if it is no longer wanted

modes.title: Picture messages failing
modes.symptom: picture messages failing to send or download
customer_says: I can't send picture messages. They just sit there saying sending and then fail.
Photos people send me by text won't download. It says tap to retry, and retrying never works.
My picture messages have stopped working. Normal texts are fine, but anything with a photo fails.
I've been trying to send a photo to my sister by text, and it just won't go.

causes.cause: a full message store on the picture messaging server
fixes: clearing space on the picture messaging server

causes.cause: an expired certificate on the picture message gateway
fixes: installing a new certificate on the picture message gateway

causes.cause: a routing fault between the data core and the picture messaging platform
fixes: re-routing picture messages through the backup platform

workarounds: send photos through an internet messaging app instead
attach photos to an email until picture messaging returns
aftercare: tap retry on any picture message that failed
restart the phone so it fetches any waiting picture messages

modes.title: Tethering not working
modes.symptom: personal hotspot sessions being refused by the network
customer_says: My hotspot has stopped working. The laptop joins it, but there's no internet through it.
I can't tether any more. Data works on the phone itself, but not on anything connected to it.
The personal hotspot on my phone connects and then says no internet. I use it every day for work.
My tablet won't get online through my phone's hotspot, although the phone itself is fine.

causes.cause: a tethering entitlement removed from plans during a tariff update
fixes: restoring the tethering entitlement to the affected plans

causes.cause: a faulty rule in the traffic inspection platform
fixes: disabling the faulty traffic inspection rule

causes.cause: a wrong access point name sent to phones in a settings update
fixes: sending the correct access point name to affected phones

workarounds: share the connection over a USB cable instead of Wi-Fi
use the phone itself for anything urgent until tethering returns
aftercare: switch the hotspot off and on again to start a fresh session
accept the settings message that arrives by text

wrong_customer_side: a monthly data allowance that has run out
mobile data switched off in the phone's settings
a handset that needs a software update
wrong_provider_side: a mast taken down for an upgrade
bad weather affecting signal across the region
a large public event overloading the network
a planned switch-off of the old 3G service
